evidence.sql:
SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM valid_utc) AS BIGINT) AS valid_epoch, pm25_hour, pm25_24h, api, p_close, smoke_index
       FROM projections WHERE run_id = 'fw-2026100512-h-48b9a4' AND town = 'Batu Pahat'
        AND valid_utc >= CAST('2026-10-05T23:00:00.000Z' AS TIMESTAMP) AND valid_utc < CAST('2026-10-07T05:00:00.000Z' AS TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY valid_utc

SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS hours, AVG(pm25) AS mean_pm25, MAX(CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM valid_utc) AS BIGINT)) AS latest_epoch FROM pm25
      WHERE town = 'Batu Pahat' AND valid_utc > CAST('2026-10-04T12:00:00.000Z' AS TIMESTAMP) AND valid_utc <= CAST('2026-10-05T12:00:00.000Z' AS TIMESTAMP)
      GROUP BY kind ORDER BY kind

SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM valid_utc) AS BIGINT) AS valid_epoch, pm25_24h, api, p_close, smoke_index FROM projections
      WHERE run_id = 'fw-2026100512-h-48b9a4' AND town = 'Batu Pahat' ORDER BY valid_utc

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_fires, SUM(frp) AS total_frp, SUM(CASE WHEN on_peat THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS peat_fires,
                SUM(CASE WHEN concession_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_concessions,
                MIN(lat) AS min_lat, MAX(lat) AS max_lat, MIN(lon) AS min_lon, MAX(lon) AS max_lon
           FROM fires WHERE fire_id IN ('9d6ab7db0ab96e54','553e596bfdae01cf','e9f45863fae31d01','8790d4dd320c5ce0','ff213af7d5066574','78ed74bfa5023719','f466f593ac57b40b','4d2f59eeaf857f50','9346c56f6932d290','6548bc51c5375e92','b4fbba703b92d3e5','4dc61d3e0a435738','61462e33063ede85','362edbb9fd937eaa','f5d970b37353320d','1706d4eed08ba01b','c5adfcb05d872d12','955fd475ec863107','50ce50088f64a064','d23d6e2dd67cf954','867a70dcb72d9f5b','933157f5f43cc20f')

SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM valid_utc) AS BIGINT) AS valid_epoch FROM projections
        WHERE run_id = 'fw-2026100512-h-48b9a4' AND town = 'Batu Pahat' AND pm25_hour IS NOT NULL
          AND valid_utc >= CAST('2026-10-05T23:00:00.000Z' AS TIMESTAMP) AND valid_utc < CAST('2026-10-07T05:00:00.000Z' AS TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY valid_utc

limitations: Future hours use archived model values (hindsight), as in a replay or the offline sample: a test of the method, not a true forecast.

Kepada Guru Kelas / Pentadbir Sekolah [nama sekolah],

Saya, [nama ibu/bapa], ibu/bapa kepada [nama murid] ([kelas]), ingin memaklumkan bahawa anak saya tidak akan hadir ke sekolah pada Rabu, 7 Oktober 2026 kerana keadaan jerebu.
Bacaan Indeks Pencemar Udara (IPU) purata 24 jam di Batu Pahat dijangka sekitar 219, dan anak saya [menghidap asma / mempunyai masalah pernafasan].
Makluman ini dibuat selaras dengan kelonggaran Kementerian Pendidikan yang membenarkan ibu bapa tidak menghantar anak ke sekolah semasa jerebu dengan memaklumkan pihak sekolah.

Sekian, terima kasih.
[nama ibu/bapa], [no. telefon]

MAKLUMAN KEPADA IBU BAPA

Unjuran kualiti udara menunjukkan bacaan IPU di kawasan Batu Pahat berkemungkinan melebihi 200 menjelang Rabu, 7 Oktober 2026.
Sekiranya bacaan rasmi APIMS melebihi 200, sekolah akan ditutup serta-merta dan Pengajaran dan Pembelajaran di Rumah (PdPR) akan dilaksanakan.
Sila sediakan penjagaan anak dan pastikan anak yang menghidap asma membawa ubat. Pantau pengumuman rasmi sekolah.
